Nia: Observed a bunch of 429s from new users during the onboarding flow this morning.
Nia: The starter app does aggressive prefetch (next 5 pages) to make the demo feel instant.
Nia: Example response headers: X-RI-Quota: 1/60, X-RI-Reset: 62, Retry-After: 4
Dev (sdk): Which SDK versions are in the wild? We recently bumped python prefetch default to 6 in v1.6.x. JS still at 2.
Nia: Backend uses python-sdk v1.6.3, web uses js-sdk v1.4.1.
Ravi (infra): Low trial quota + N parallel prefetch => backend rate controller trips. Also saw concurrent token refresh attempts in auth logs.
Lee (oncall): That typically becomes a retry stampede: expired token triggers multiple refreshes, then all requests retry and hit quota again.
Dev (sdk): We have a parity gap: JS coalesces auth refresh, Python does not. I'll ship a small fix to add a refresh lock and reduce prefetch default for new installs on trial accounts.
Dev (sdk): Short patch pseudocode:
```
lock = get_lock_for(cred_id)
with lock:
  if token_expired():
    refresh()
# Respect Retry-After header on 429s
on_429(resp):
  wait = int(resp.headers.get('Retry-After', 1))
  sleep(max(base_backoff * 2**attempt, wait))
```
Ravi (infra): We can also honor the new X-RI-Quota header client-side: if remaining <= 3, SDK should switch to conservative mode (concurrency=1) and stop background prefetch. We'll document the header soon.
Lee (oncall): Immediate mitigation: - flip PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=1 in the sample app env for trials (Nia?) - infra add a small edge smoothing window for UI-origin traffic (Ravi) - SDK hotfix for auth coalescing + retry-after (Dev)
Nia: Done: sample app env var set and staging deployed. deploy-bot: deploy-staging succeeded for starter-app @ 2026-01-09T18:32:10Z
Dev (sdk): Opening PR now, adding unit tests for concurrent refresh + integration test for low X-RI-Quota handling. Will add a soft warning log when header shows low remaining.
Ravi (infra): Also consider idempotency keys for prefetch endpoints to avoid double-counting on retry success.
Lee (oncall): I'll draft the incident note and include links to the PR + sample app change. Keep this thread updated if residual 429s surface after rollout.
